approval_statement: Continue the experiment through statistical confirmation and simplify where necessary to finish. V6 applies a support-preserving LID-DS-2021 repair: lower the confirmatory content cap and its four matching allocation counts from 44 to 40 after the fresh V5 preflight found only 43 content-unique valid validation recordings in one scenario. The repair preserves phase disjointness, all other frozen protocol values, the required 15 scenarios x 40 = 600 normal and 600 attack test units, and the previously authorized maximum of 440 CPU-h.
limitations: This V6 approval changes only the LID-DS-2021 confirmatory cap/count from 44 to 40 after the V5 preflight found an insufficient 43-recording content-unique validation stratum under the 44 cap.
The uniform cap preserves the frozen minimum LID confirmatory support exactly: 15 scenarios x 40 equals 600 normal and 600 attack test units.
Confirmatory execution remains prohibited if fresh V6 pilot/preflight, support, leakage, truth-lock, artifact-integrity, and total-cost gates do not pass.
The maximum authorized computation remains 440 CPU-h; no over-budget execution is authorized.

The frozen statistical protocol reports uncertainty only where its cluster and stochastic-design assumptions are met; it does not turn deterministic-versus-stochastic descriptive contrasts or HAI two-cluster results into unsupported significance claims.
